recipes.name: Quick and Easy Potato Casserole
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps.text: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain.
While potatoes are cooking, melt butter in a small skillet over medium heat. Add onion and sauté until golden brown. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Mash potatoes with condensed soup and sour cream until smooth and creamy. Mix in onions, 3/4 cup Cheddar cheese, salt, and pepper. Spoon into a 2-quart casserole dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup Cheddar over top and bake for 10 more minutes. Serve hot.

raw_recipe.headline: Quick and Easy Potato Casserole
raw_recipe.description: This potato casserole is made with cream of chicken soup for extra creaminess! Plus lots of Cheddar cheese and sour cream for a bit of tang.

review.reviewBody: Instead of dicing, I sliced the potatoes and boiled them just a little so that they were still firm. When adding other ingredients, I didn't mash them, because I didn't want a mashed potato casserole.. still wanted them chunky. I think boiling time would solve the soupy issue. I used cream of potato instead of cream of chicken, a little milk, and added pinch of salt, pepper, garlic, oregano, and basil. I used mozzarella and sharp cheddar cheese. Maybe I created my own recipe lol. This is definitely a recipe that needs tailoring according to your own personal taste.

Why go to the hassle of peeling and cooking potatoes?!! Use a 2lb bag of Frozen cubed/diced Potatoes. Ore Ida is a Great brand with or without the peppers & onions. (I myself, saute a small vidalia onion finally chopped in a little butter until it's opaque) I also use the Cream of Chicken mixed with 8 oz. of Sour Cream. I use 2 cups of Sharp Cheddar Cheese=reserving some for the top. I also have added 1 cup of cubed/diced ham, 6-8 slices of crumbled Bacon, 1 roll of sausage browned/drained for a little more flavor. A little salt & pepper to taste. Mix it all together & put in a well-greased 9 x 11 dish. Cover with foil & back 45 - 50 min. Remove foil & cook another 10-15 min. till brown & bubbly! This recipe will give you GREAT Reviews! It's always a hit when I serve it.

Made as written and this was ok. Simple enough but it needed more flavor. Celery would have been a nice addition. After draining the potatoes I let them "dry" a bit and then gave them a rough smash. No soupy consistency here but I do feel the overall dish needs more seasoning. Chives alone would have amped this up. Parsley too.

This was sooooo good however I made some changes. I used frozen southern hash browns that I heated in the microwave until the chill was off of them. I also did not add chopped onion and added almost a whole small container of sour cream. I will make this again.

Good Recipe! Loved the sauteed onions. Everyone enjoyed it. I had 9 potatoes, so I decided to throw an extra in since some reviews said the recipe was too wet, but ours turned out a tad dry so I think the amounts would be just right how the recipe is written. Make sure you bake it enough to get a crunchy top, That was the best part! I would make this recipe again
Added a little garlic powder is all. Very good recipe.
When I make this recipe I save time by using Potatoes O'Brien since it already has diced onions and peppers mixed in. My casserole is always finished, people enjoy it...and easy to make.
my husband thought it was awesome. Although I added some olive oil about 2 tsps and I also added a large garlic clove. That helped with the flavor.

Not exactly what I had hoped for. It was very runny and had a weird taste to it. My friend uses this same recipe, but boils the potatoes with the skins on them until tender, then cuts them into quarters and blends in the other ingredients. I'll try that next time.

I don't like peeling potatos, but this recipe was worth it! I used cream of mushroom because I didn't have any cream of chicken in the house, but it was still very tasty. They made very good leftovers too!!
OK recipe. Lacked flavor. Would recommend adding more cheese and possibly garlic salt, bacon bits, or fried onions.
This cheesy potato casserole was a hit at a Sunday brunch! I will continue to use this recipe for years to come.
We just loved it. Great recipe, thanks for the save. Lol
Delicious!

It was so good. I can't rave enough. I was hesitant putting cream of chicken in my potatoes but it was perfect and the flavor is so good... perfect comfort food. I followed the recipe as written. I wouldn't want to change a thing..thank you for posting this dish..

This was ok. I needed a cheesy potato recipe that didn't take too long and this one sounded good. I liked the idea of the chicken soup. I'll probably add some garlic salt to the mix next time for more flavor.
it was great when i added sour cream and ketchup after cooking
It turned out just as all the comments had suggested. It tasted great, and even my picky children enjoyed it.
Very good; my fiance loved it (and he doesn't like mashed potatoes); next time I'll add a few more of my own seasonings.
Wow this was the best mashed potatoes I have ever had. I made it for company one night and they loved it too. Definately will be making this again.
